rationale.campaign_length: 24项专属定义之外还有长期研究与形成准备。
rationale.colonization: 已读主线不以远洋殖民为重心。
rationale.complexity: 建筑、研究、资源与统治者状态需要并行准备。
rationale.dark_story: 严重实验损失与分档升格构成阴暗转折。
rationale.difficulty: 研究门槛和人物风险提高难度，未实机测试。
rationale.diplomacy: 主要协调阶层、教团与邻国，而非联盟玩法。
rationale.early_pressure: 弱小地缘处境与周边强邻造成前期压力。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 开局法师与造神工程贯穿全线。
rationale.narrative_density: 小国复兴—学院—神性实验构成连续故事。
rationale.tall_play: 学院、大学、法师塔是核心长期投资。
rationale.trade_economy: 玻璃、瓷器、葡萄酒等资源影响研究前置。
rationale.warfare: 对抗强邻并扩张布勒瓦尔，战争服务研究国家的空间需求。

identity.appearance: 1444太阳精灵王国，卡罗迪尔一世为强力法师。
identity.formation_scope: 可条件性形成凤凰帝国F38/F97；曾为F42者保留瓦拉姆哈尔任务潜在资格。

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
魔法艺术知识学院，俗称乌勒米什伊迪格拉特大学，由卡罗迪尔一世·瓦拉姆祖伊尔创建于1446年，迅速成为布勒瓦尔学习和研究魔法的主要中心。伊尔利亚姆的戴拉里欧斯死后，国王取消了王国中对人类魔法师的禁令，使该学院的魔法师人数增加了两倍，大学因此大受欢迎。

在贾德帝国时期，即使在其他大学如布拉桑大学、迈杜鲁巴尔大学和贾德扎尔大学成立之后，乌勒米什伊迪格拉特大学仍然是一个重要而有声望的地方。它向所有人开放教育；不过，它为那些专注于太阳精灵学术魔法和布勒瓦尔修会魔法的人提供了最广泛的课程。

在神圣先驱「仁慈者」忒萨林多尔的领导下，这所大学成为了第一所能够教授布勒瓦尔光明魔法的世俗机构，这也是卡罗迪尔建立这所大学时的目标，即培养新一代依靠奥术而非神术的驱魔祭司。
description.text_en:
The House of Knowledge of the Magical Arts, commonly known as the University of Ulmiš Idiqlat, was founded in 1446 by Karodir I Varamzuir, and quickly became the primary center of learning and study of magic in Bulwar. The university gained massive popularity when the king revoked the ban on human magi in his kingdom after the death of Taelarios of Irrliam, tripling the amount of magi of the institution.

During the Jadd Empire, Ulmiš Idiqlat remained an important and prestigious site even after the founding of other universities such as those in Brasan, Medurubar, and Jaddanzar during the Magi Renaissance. It opened education to all; however, it offered the widest array of courses to those who focus on the Sun Elf scholarly magic, and the Bulwari magic of Order.

Under the Divine-herald Tezalindor the Kind, the university became the first secular institution enabled to teach the Bulwari magic of Light, something that Karodir aimed for when he established it, training a new generation of Exorcist-priests who relied on arcane magic rather than divine.

description.text:
布勒瓦尔大会之后，吉斯胡拉姆国王达亚姆将一块土地赐给了凤凰军团的一名杰出队长瓦拉马尔，他与部下一起在此建起了瓦拉姆哈尔城。

自建城以来，特别是在与哈比伦的战争期间以及后来杰西丝帝国灭亡之后，瓦拉马尔不得不时刻应对鹰身女妖的袭击和入侵。为此，瓦拉姆哈尔建立起一支训练有素的特种部队，白凤凰卫队，由高度机动的部队组成，能够迅速应对鹰身女妖的威胁，并能迅速部署进行防御或援助。
description.text_en:
After the Great Assembly of Bulwar, King Daryam of Gišhuram gave a plot of land to Varamar, a distinguished captain of the Phoenix Legions, who founded the city of Varamhar alongside his subordinates.

Since its foundation, and especially during the war against Harpylen and later after the fall of the Jexisian Empire, Varamhar has had to deal with harpy raids and incursions. So Varamar had a special unit trained, the White Phoenix Guard, who were made up of highly mobile troops that would be able to swiftly respond to the threats of harpies and could quickly be deployed for defense or aid.

description.text: 让一所大学与你的政府挂钩的好处之一是可以接触到大量的新鲜人才。瓦拉姆哈尔和贾德帝国也利用了这一点。卡罗迪尔规定，所有该学院的成员都必须在政府办公室实习，贾德帝国也延续了该规定。法师尤其受到重视。他们中的许多人帮助政府完成日常任务，而最有才华的人则被提供军事职位或被转移到秘密项目。
description.text_en: One of the benefits of having a university tied to your government is the access to a large pool of fresh talent. And both Varamhar and the Jadd Empire eagerly made use of that. Karodir instituted, and the Jadd Empire maintained, an obligatory internship period in government offices for all who attended the Academy. Magi were prized. Many of them aided the government in its daily tasks, while the most talented were offered military posts or moved on to secret projects.

description.text: 布勒瓦尔的美食之一是贾赫阳光。这是一种甜白葡萄酒，由在阳光下长期发酵的葡萄干酿制而成。在整个布勒瓦尔只有几个地方可以装瓶，它的稀有使它在坎诺上层阶级中备受珍视。然而，最高质量的葡萄酒是在瓦拉姆哈尔生产的，拥有一瓶瓦拉姆哈尔贾赫阳光是地位的明确标志。
description.text_en: One of the great delicacies of Bulwar is Jaherian Sunlight. It is a sweet white wine made of raisins long-fermented in the sun. There are but a few locations throughout Bulwar where it is bottled, and its rarity has made it highly prized among the Cannorian upper class. However, the highest quality wine is made in Varamhar, and getting hold of a bottle of Varamhar Jaherian Sunlight is a clear sign of status.

description.text: 杰西丝帝国灭亡后，布勒瓦尔在当地精灵总督中分裂。一些人很快就崩溃了，例如第二次余烬战争中的达拉兰德王国，而另一些人则兴旺起来，获得了力量。在一片混乱中，科林迪勒·瓦拉姆祖伊尔，达拉兰德国王的左右手，与布勒瓦尔十二家族密谋刺杀他的国王。阴谋是成功的，科林迪勒在战争结束时从达拉兰德手中获得了自己的王国。他的继任者们也学会了如何处理他们得到的这副牌，不是依靠军事力量，而是依靠诡计来保持苏兰平原上最弱的王国的独立性。
description.text_en: After the fall of the Jexisian Empire, Bulwar divided itself among the local elven governors. Some thrived and drew powers to themselves while others shattered like the Kingdom of Dalarand during the Second Cinder War. Within this chaos, Kelindil Varamzuir, right hand of the king of Dalarand, plotted against his king with the Twelve of Bulwar to assassinate him. The plot was successful, and Kelindil carved his kingdom of Dalarand at the end of the war. His successors also learned to deal with the deck they were given, relying not on military might but on subterfuge to retain their independence as the weakest kingdom of the Suran Plain.

description.text:
从历史上看，鹰身女妖的袭击对经过布勒瓦尔的商人来说是一场噩梦，尤其是在靠近鹰身女妖山的地方。在古代，吉斯胡拉姆王国采取了一项建设计划：建造有屋顶的城市来抵御鹰身女妖的袭击。

瓦拉姆哈尔王国建立之初，许多保护设施已经年久失修，但阿娅拉伦的威胁不断上升，迫使瓦拉姆哈尔王室恢复了屋顶保护设施的昔日荣光。作为交换，他们赢得了民众的爱戴和商人们信赖的声誉，因为他们更愿意在一个他们或他们的货物不会突然被一群突如其来的鹰身女妖带走的地方进行交易。

但卡罗迪尔不仅修复了现有的集市城，还对其进行了改进。占星家之城和瓦拉姆哈尔的首都吉斯胡拉姆的屋顶由附魔的青铜瓦片组成，可以用魔法收回。这既增强了瓦拉姆哈尔首都的防御能力，又让市民可以在城市街道上欣赏夜空美景。
description.text_en:
Harpy raids had historically been a nightmare for merchants traveling through Bulwar, especially close to the Hills. In antiquity, the kingdom of Gišhuram responded with a program of construction: roofed cities to protect against harpy raids.

Many of those protections were in disrepair when Varamhar was established, but the rising menace of Ayarallen forced the Varamhari crown to restore the roof protections to their former glory. In exchange, they gained the love of the populace and a reputation of reliance among merchants, as they were much more eager to trade in a location where they or their goods did not just suddenly get carried away by an unexpected flock of harpies.

But Karodir not only repaired the existing Bazaar cities but improved them. Gišhuram, the city of astrologers and Varamhar’s capital, was protected with a roof composed of enchanted bronze tiles that could be retracted using magic. This allowed to increase the defensiveness of Varamhar’s capital while at the same time allowing the citizens to keep the view of the night sky from the city streets.

description.text:
与其他偏爱近战法术的太阳精灵不同，埃德玛吉是瓦拉姆哈尔魔法师，擅长强大的远程法术，是太阳精灵传统与布勒瓦尔修会魔法的结合。在骑兵为王的苏兰平原战场上，这些法术耗资巨大且难以施展，但对城墙等静止目标和攻城车或纪律严明的敌方阵型等移动缓慢的目标特别有效。

在沙漠军团围攻吉斯胡拉姆期间，尽管该城遭到布拉农河两侧军队的攻击，但埃德玛吉还是成功地将敌人挡在了外面。经过一年多的抵抗，该城在阿卡勒舍斯的阿拉什死后投降，当时卡罗迪尔从阿拉斯巴尔的地牢中获释，并被允许流放以换取他的王国。

虽然一些埃德玛吉跟随卡罗迪尔加入了贾赫的典范，但他们中的大多数人还是留在了这里，加入了新生的贾德帝国的行列，并因参与在罗祆的对抗命令秩序的战争而闻名。
description.text_en:
Unlike other Sun Elves who prefer close-combat spells, the Erdmagi are Varamhari magi specialized in powerful long-distance spells, a combination of Sun Elven traditions and the Bulwari magic of Order. These spells are costly and difficult to apply on the battlefields of the Suran Plain, where cavalry is king, but they are especially effective against stationary targets, such as walls, and slow-moving targets like siege engines or disciplined enemy formations.

During the siege of Gišhuram by the Desert Legion, the Erdmagi managed to keep the enemy at bay despite the city being attacked by both sides of the Buranun. Resisting the siege for over a year, the city surrendered after the death of Araš of Akalšes, when Karodir was released from the dungeons of Arašbar and was allowed to go into exile in exchange for his kingdom.

While some of the Erdmagi followed Karodir and joined the Jaherian Exemplars, most of them remained and joined the ranks of the nascent Jadd Empire, being renowned for their participation in the wars in Rahen against the Command.

description.text:
「征服者在世界遥远的边缘凝视着阳光普照的大海，
只觉得黑暗不堪，没有胜利的喜悦。
他的血将被征服，但世界却把他打瘸了，
他流着烈火的大眼泪，用雷鸣般的声音宣告。
『我已到达我的顶点，我要达到的最高境界，
因为没有更多的世界可以征服，我的灵魂被撕裂了。』
他转身面对他的帝国，听天由命，
贾赫的时代已经过去，他正在等待死亡。
直到有人拿起了衣钵。
凤凰王冠在等着你。」
-摘自萨拉达·拉祖米尔的《贾赫的连祷》
description.text_en:
"The conqueror stood at the world far edge and stared across the sunlit sea,
And felt aught but crushing darkness, No thrill of victory.
His blood sang for conquest but the world had struck him lame,
And he wept great tears of fire and in thundering voice proclaimed.
"I have reached my zenith, the highest I shall mark,
For there are no more worlds to conquer, my soul is torn apart."
He turned to face his empire, resigned to his fate,
Jaher's time had passed, his death he did await.
Till one takes up the mantle.
The Phoenix Crown awaits."
-from the Litany of Jaher by Sarada Razumir

description.text: 太阳精灵一直被认为是苏雷尔的天选者，注定要为他的光荣回归铺平道路。然而，即使帝国在杰西丝统治的灰烬中崛起，其境内仍有相当数量的少数人拒绝追随真正的信仰，更不用说那些帝国之外的人仍然信奉死去的神。为了对抗这种情况，苏雷尔的祭司们组成了真理之光修会，将太阳圣殿的教义传播到世界最遥远的角落，他们证明了自己很适合完成这项任务。
description.text_en: The Sun Elves have long been styled the Chosen of Surael, destined to pave the way for his glorious return. Yet even as the Empire rose from the ashes of Jexis' reign there was a significant minority within its borders who refused to follow the true faith, not to mention those outside the Empire who still clung to dead gods. To combat this the priests of Surael formed The Order of the Light of Truth to spread the teachings of the Sun Temple to the farthest corners of the world, a task they proved apt in achieving.

name.text_en: The Order of the Light of Truth

description.text: 凤凰帝国是一个高耸入云的神庙和宫殿，从永恒之火的宫殿到黎明神庙，它的土地充满了做梦都想不到的奇迹，覆盖着大理石和黄金。随着时间的推移，精灵贵族拥有比大多数城镇都大的不断扩张的地产，建造越来越宏伟的建筑，这并不罕见。随着它的复兴，新皇帝们开始着手建造超越人类王国的伟大建筑，以巩固精灵领导和和平的新时代的荣耀。
description.text_en: The Phoenix Empire is one of soaring temples and palaces that reach towards the heavens, from the Palace of Eternal Fire to the Dawn temple its lands are filled with wonders undreamed, draped in marble and gold. It is not uncommon for the Elvish nobility to have sprawling estates larger than most towns as they add grander and grander edifices as the centuries wear on. With its resurgence the new Emperors undertook great projects to craft edifices to surpass anything found in the kingdoms of man and cement the glory of a new age of Elven leadership and peace.

name.text_en: The Empire of Palaces and Temples

description.text:
在过去的几年里，贾赫和杰西丝带领着世界上最优秀的军队，世人在他们的征战中从未见过。传说中无数的军团穿着闪闪发光的金甲，手持闪亮的银剑，遍布整个坎诺。自从杰西丝倒下后，凤凰军团骄傲的战士传统已经成为历史，再也没有金色的战士为太阳精灵人民的荣耀而穿越阳洲。

既然我们伟大的帝国已经从灰烬中重生，军团也必须前进。在岁月的重压下，那些传奇的刀刃已经生锈变钝太久了。凤凰军团将再次崛起，太阳精灵的敌人将再次为他们的离去而颤抖。
description.text_en:
In years past Jaher and Jexis lead the finest armies that the world has ever seen in their conquests. Legends of endless ranks of Legionaries clad in glittering golden armour and armed with shining silver blades are told across all of Cannor. Since the fall of Jexis the proud warrior traditions of the Phoenix Legions has faded into history and no more golden warriors march across Sarhal for the glory of the Sun Elf people.

Now that our great Empire has been reformed from the ashes, so too must the Legions march. For too long have those blades of legend been left to rust and dull under the weight of years. Once more the Phoenix Legions shall rise and once more the enemies of the Sun Elves shall tremble at their passing.

name.text: 在灰烬中，凤凰军团崛起
name.text_en: From Ashes, the Phoenix Legion rises

description.text: 贸易是帝国最重要的活动之一，精灵们的大量财富来自于东方的商品，这些商品沿着帝国的贸易路线运往西部的坎诺。为了促进这种贸易，也为了给本国商人阶层提供优势，帝国政府开始在其庞大的领地内建立一系列被称为贸易办事处的中站，商人们可以在这里休息并为长途旅行做准备。
description.text_en: Trade is one of the most vital practices in the Empire, much of the Elves' vast wealth is drawn from eastern goods traveling along the Empire's trade routes to be sold in the western lands of Cannor. To facilitate this trade, as well as to give an edge to their own merchant class, the Imperial government set about establishing a series of way stations called The Offices of Trade throughout its vast holdings where their merchants could rest and prepare for long journeys.

description.text: 在布勒瓦尔的皇家首都，靠近皇宫，坐落着一大片由黄金和天青石组成的建筑群。它的官方名称是皇家进步学院，但大多数人都知道它的另一个名字是镀金动物园。帝国未来的统治者都是在这里受训的，许多贵族家族都把自己的子嗣送到这里来，为的是在帝国官僚机构中获得优待和地位。它的黑暗目的是训练帝国庞大的间谍和刺客网络。据说，在坎诺的每一个宫廷里，在每一个法师的集会上，动物园里都有一打耳朵在听着每一个字，每人背后都有一打锋利的刀子。
description.text_en: In the imperial capital of Bulwar, near to the Imperial Palace, lies a vast and sprawling complex of gold and lapis lazuli. Its official name is the Imperial Academy of Progress but most know it by another name The Gilded Menagerie. It is here that the future governors of the Empire are trained, many a noble house has sent its scions here in order to gain favour and position within the Imperial Bureaucracy. Its darker purpose is the training ground of the Empire's vast network of spies and assassins. It is said that in every court in Cannor, in every gathering of mages the Menagerie has a dozen sets of ears listening to every word and a dozen sharpened knives at every back.

description.text: 凤凰帝国和它的太阳精灵统治者统治着广阔而多样的土地，从地平线延伸到地平线。在这个帝国里，在天选者的开明统治下，文化的交汇、贸易和融合比其他任何地方都多。太阳精灵已经接受了他们的命运，因为他们终有一天会在他们光辉的统治下领导整个世界，并且接受所有的低等种族，接受所有的种族，只要他们跪在比他们更好的人的脚下。
description.text_en: The Phoenix Empire and its Sun Elf rulers are masters over vast and diverse lands stretching from horizon to horizon. It is within this Empire more than any other that cultures meet, trade and mingle under the enlightened rule of the chosen. The Sun Elves have accepted their destiny as those who will one day lead the entire world under their glorious rule and accept all the lesser races and accept all into the fold, provided they kneel at the feet of their betters.

Yet even as the Empire rose from the ashes of Jexis' reign there was a significant minority within its borders who refused to follow the true faith, not to mention those outside the Empire who still clung to dead gods. To combat this the priests of Surael formed The Order of the Light of Truth to spread the teachings of the Sun Temple to the farthest corners of the world, a task they proved apt in achieving.

name.text_en: The Order of the Light of Truth

description.text: 凤凰帝国是一个高耸入云的神庙和宫殿，从永恒之火的宫殿到黎明神庙，它的土地充满了做梦都想不到的奇迹，覆盖着大理石和黄金。随着时间的推移，精灵贵族拥有比大多数城镇都大的不断扩张的地产，建造越来越宏伟的建筑，这并不罕见。随着它的复兴，新皇帝们开始着手建造超越人类王国的伟大建筑，以巩固精灵领导和和平的新时代的荣耀。
description.text_en: The Phoenix Empire is one of soaring temples and palaces that reach towards the heavens, from the Palace of Eternal Fire to the Dawn temple its lands are filled with wonders undreamed, draped in marble and gold. It is not uncommon for the Elvish nobility to have sprawling estates larger than most towns as they add grander and grander edifices as the centuries wear on. With its resurgence the new Emperors undertook great projects to craft edifices to surpass anything found in the kingdoms of man and cement the glory of a new age of Elven leadership and peace.

name.text_en: The Empire of Palaces and Temples

description.text:
在过去的几年里，贾赫和杰西丝带领着世界上最优秀的军队，世人在他们的征战中从未见过。传说中无数的军团穿着闪闪发光的金甲，手持闪亮的银剑，遍布整个坎诺。自从杰西丝倒下后，凤凰军团骄傲的战士传统已经成为历史，再也没有金色的战士为太阳精灵人民的荣耀而穿越阳洲。

既然我们伟大的帝国已经从灰烬中重生，军团也必须前进。在岁月的重压下，那些传奇的刀刃已经生锈变钝太久了。凤凰军团将再次崛起，太阳精灵的敌人将再次为他们的离去而颤抖。
description.text_en:
In years past Jaher and Jexis lead the finest armies that the world has ever seen in their conquests. Legends of endless ranks of Legionaries clad in glittering golden armour and armed with shining silver blades are told across all of Cannor. Since the fall of Jexis the proud warrior traditions of the Phoenix Legions has faded into history and no more golden warriors march across Sarhal for the glory of the Sun Elf people.

Now that our great Empire has been reformed from the ashes, so too must the Legions march. For too long have those blades of legend been left to rust and dull under the weight of years. Once more the Phoenix Legions shall rise and once more the enemies of the Sun Elves shall tremble at their passing.

name.text: 在灰烬中，凤凰军团崛起
name.text_en: From Ashes, the Phoenix Legion rises

description.text: 贸易是帝国最重要的活动之一，精灵们的大量财富来自于东方的商品，这些商品沿着帝国的贸易路线运往西部的坎诺。为了促进这种贸易，也为了给本国商人阶层提供优势，帝国政府开始在其庞大的领地内建立一系列被称为贸易办事处的中站，商人们可以在这里休息并为长途旅行做准备。
description.text_en: Trade is one of the most vital practices in the Empire, much of the Elves' vast wealth is drawn from eastern goods traveling along the Empire's trade routes to be sold in the western lands of Cannor. To facilitate this trade, as well as to give an edge to their own merchant class, the Imperial government set about establishing a series of way stations called The Offices of Trade throughout its vast holdings where their merchants could rest and prepare for long journeys.

description.text: 在布勒瓦尔的皇家首都，靠近皇宫，坐落着一大片由黄金和天青石组成的建筑群。它的官方名称是皇家进步学院，但大多数人都知道它的另一个名字是镀金动物园。帝国未来的统治者都是在这里受训的，许多贵族家族都把自己的子嗣送到这里来，为的是在帝国官僚机构中获得优待和地位。它的黑暗目的是训练帝国庞大的间谍和刺客网络。据说，在坎诺的每一个宫廷里，在每一个法师的集会上，动物园里都有一打耳朵在听着每一个字，每人背后都有一打锋利的刀子。
description.text_en: In the imperial capital of Bulwar, near to the Imperial Palace, lies a vast and sprawling complex of gold and lapis lazuli. Its official name is the Imperial Academy of Progress but most know it by another name The Gilded Menagerie. It is here that the future governors of the Empire are trained, many a noble house has sent its scions here in order to gain favour and position within the Imperial Bureaucracy. Its darker purpose is the training ground of the Empire's vast network of spies and assassins. It is said that in every court in Cannor, in every gathering of mages the Menagerie has a dozen sets of ears listening to every word and a dozen sharpened knives at every back.

description.text: 凤凰帝国和它的太阳精灵统治者统治着广阔而多样的土地，从地平线延伸到地平线。在这个帝国里，在天选者的开明统治下，文化的交汇、贸易和融合比其他任何地方都多。太阳精灵已经接受了他们的命运，因为他们终有一天会在他们光辉的统治下领导整个世界，并且接受所有的低等种族，接受所有的种族，只要他们跪在比他们更好的人的脚下。
description.text_en: The Phoenix Empire and its Sun Elf rulers are masters over vast and diverse lands stretching from horizon to horizon. It is within this Empire more than any other that cultures meet, trade and mingle under the enlightened rule of the chosen. The Sun Elves have accepted their destiny as those who will one day lead the entire world under their glorious rule and accept all the lesser races and accept all into the fold, provided they kneel at the feet of their betters.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不愿等待多项前置条件或承担统治者与实验风险。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先稳住强邻，再同步经济与魔法条件，最后推进研究与升格。
player_overview.overview: 瓦拉姆哈尔以强力法师君主开局，却必须先应对周边强邻。你会建设学院、组织法师、调度商贸资源，让魔法从个人能力变成国家工程，再挑战制造神祇的终极目标。实验会损害地方，统治者与准备条件又决定结局；这是一场用整个国家支撑的危险研究。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢法师君主、科研工程和神化叙事。
signature_features: 学院、法师组织与物资共同支撑神性工程。
强力法师君主决定开局机会与后期风险。
升格有不同结果，实验并非无代价奖励。

values.rationale: 学院、城市与研究提供公共收益；神性工程事件使609省严重荒废并减少发展，研究政治容许高风险代价。没有证实全部人口资源化指控，不因太阳精灵、宗教或扩张扣分。
red_flags: 实验造成地方严重荒废与发展损失
